rounding_point.rule: Magnitude quotient/remainder, ties away from zero, then saturation; negative right shift is not the rounding rule.

superaccumulator_design.mechanism: Decode sign/exponent/significand, shift integer significand into common quantum, add with carries to fixed limbs, merge limbs exactly, round once nearest-even with guard/sticky bits. No per-worker floating rounding. Check finite input and count bound before accumulation.
superaccumulator_design.limits: Python exact-integer design model; not a claimed C limb implementation. Exact input decomposition and bounded limb/carry/rounding design are the original requested transfer artifact.

quadratic_interpolation.operation_comparison: Two stored endpoint ordinates and two weighted products plus addition/division per segment; x*x polynomial needs one product and no table for this particular known quadratic. Binary search costs O(log knots); validation costs O(knots).

missed_feature.required_revision: Lipschitz bound or adaptive subdivision with a certified derivative/curvature bound, otherwise unobserved narrow features remain possible.

filter_poles.scope: First-order |feedback|<1 applies only to this recurrence; it is not a general multi-pole criterion.

solver_sensitivity.threshold: Scaled pivot screening is a diagnostic policy, not a condition-number bound.
solver_sensitivity.iterative: An absolute residual stop, iteration cap and unchanged-iterate stagnation are separate outcomes. A small residual alone cannot certify forward accuracy.

euler.stability: For y=-rate*y, multiplier1-rate*h. Decay requires0<rate*h<2; equality2 oscillates without decay.
euler.model_change: For yprime=1-y and y(0)=1, exact solution stays1; the old pure-decay simulation is wrong even if its recurrence test passes. For a two-compartment conservative model integrate both components and verify their sum, rather than imposing the single-state decay assertion.

layout_cache_model.all_fields: When x,y and24 label bytes are consumed, useful bytes5120; AoS co-locates each record while SoA traverses separate streams. Alignment/start offsets, padding, actual misses and prefetching require separate observations.
layout_cache_model.stable_handle: IDs survive compaction/reorder while indices do not; lookup is O(n) in bounded16-store. Slot/index/generation indirection can give O(1) but adds generation exhaustion and owner lifetime obligations.
